text:
sam_ae: Heads up — small ratecard change incoming that affects POC discounts (need quick ops/approval).
jia_chan: what changed? link?
sam_ae: POC discount default lowered from 20% -> 15% for commit-less trials. Reason: abuse/oversubscribe on burst. Docs: https://redwood.internal/ratecards/v3/notes (private)
emma_dealdesk: @sam_ae can you paste the diff? we need to confirm grandfathering for active POCs.
sam_ae: Sure — snippet below:
```
- poc_discount_pct: 20
+ poc_discount_pct: 15
  applies_to: "trial, poc_no_commit"
  effective_from: "2025-11-01"
```
jia_chan: active POCs created before 2025-11-01 should be grandfathered per previous guidance?
emma_dealdesk: Yes — policy says active trials keep old discount until contract signature. I'll flag for exception if needed.
andrew_fin: Quick calc: 15% saves ~ $4.2k monthly for median POC token usage vs 20%. Fine but watch churn impact.
olivia_legal: No legal blockers from terms side. We should update ratecard legal tags and STD contract template note.
emma_dealdesk: Requesting fast-track approval from deal desk to publish change and update quoting templates. Can @andrew_fin confirm no accounting/reg recognition issues?
andrew_fin: Confirmed — it's a pricing policy update, not a billing reissue. No retro billing.
emma_dealdesk: ratecard-bot: request approval for ratecard v3.2.1 change (poc_discount_pct 20->15)
ratecard-bot: Approval request created: https://redwood.internal/ratecard/approvals/3278 — reviewers: @emma_dealdesk, @andrew_fin, @olivia_legal.
emma_dealdesk: Approving now. :white_check_mark:
andrew_fin: Approving. :thumbsup:
olivia_legal: Approving.
sam_ae: Thanks! Action items: 1) ops (jia) publish patch note + quick note to AEs with rationale, 2) sales templates updated (emma), 3) billing/finance note (andrew).
jia_chan: I'll push the patch to the portal and add a short FAQ blurb for AEs. ETA 2 hours.
emma_dealdesk: I'll update deal desk playbook + add exception form link.
sam_ae: tagging a few AEs on impacted deals in Notion workspace so we can handle grandfathering.
ratecard-bot: Ratecard v3.2.1 published to staging at 1738204600.
jia_chan: Live in prod in 10m, sending announcement to #sales-all after prod window.
emma_dealdesk: Thanks all — keeping this short since it's a small change but high-touch for some POCs. Ping me if a field rep needs an exception. :handshake:
